critical_code_review_comments: reservations router: PATCH /reservations/{id}/status returns raw reservation dict (spreads MongoDB doc after clean/NO_ID). Fine, but note publish(bus) uses same doc — ensure status_history entries never leak _id. Currently protected by NO_ID projection; ok.

conversations reply endpoint sends via whatsapp_service.send_human_reply which logs 'not_connected' warnings for Baileys when using simulator provider — non-blocking, message still persists in DB and shows in UI. Consider skipping outbound send when provider==simulator to reduce warning noise.

test_regression_waautoma_flows.py: hardcodes public URL fallback https://baileys-gateway-app.preview.emergentagent.com. When run in parallel via pytest-xdist against the preview host, TLS reads to /auth/login occasionally time out at 15s — recommend either bumping timeout to 30s or reading BACKEND_URL first (localhost) with public URL as fallback for CI stability. Not an app bug.

Reservation booking prompt: AI-generated reservation_number is an int on the backend (101, 102, …) but human-facing strings/UI show 'R-101'. Both the frontend testid and API use raw int — consistent, but consider adding a helper `reservation_code` field ('R-101') to responses to match the AI's natural language and testids like reservation-card-R-101.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reservations reservation_number is stored as int in Mongo (101, 102, ...) — UI uses raw int in data-testid (reservation-card-101 not R-101). AI reply text says 'R-101' though. Public-URL preview host has intermittent TLS read timeouts at 15s on /auth/login when hit in parallel; prefer BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 or a 30s timeout. simulator/message payload requires {phone, text} (not 'message'). Providing a fully-qualified street address that includes a digit + city (e.g. 'House 12, Street 5, Gulberg Block C, Lahore') + a contact-number sentence is sufficient for AI to price + confirm delivery orders in a single message. Test-created reservations R-101..R-104 remain; safe to leave.
